It lets through the agent who paid 4-year garden service, 142 supervised plantings, soil exam, annual charter fees and catches everything else. Open the tundra and you find a clerk, open the dune and you find a bill, open the zenith and you find a date. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
